issue: District evaluation describes OWDL/TWDL and parent-denial/ESL placements, but does not map parallel English-only classrooms to each target campus.
decision: Keep campus delivery unresolved absent direct named-campus evidence.

issue: Programme options and comparisons with general education do not identify the delivery structure of every DL campus. Contreras has its own explicit parallel-programme statement.
decision: Use campus-specific evidence; do not apply Contreras to all district schools.

issue: The CAL district entry checks both Strand within School and Whole School. The choice guide differentiates choice schools and in-house options without a DL delivery crosswalk.
decision: Keep unresolved campuses; do not flatten the mixed district into one delivery model.

issue: The application and limited-space policy documents voluntary DL participation but does not establish parallel non-DL classes at every campus.
decision: Lottery or voluntary admission alone does not establish strand delivery.

issue: Application and disclosure form documents programme entry, not the proportion of the campus receiving DL.
decision: Retain allocation data without assigning delivery from the application process.

issue: Published DL language ratios and generic comparisons with English-only programmes do not identify the enrolled campus-wide participation share.
An immersion/bilingual school description and programme history do not explicitly establish whether all current classrooms participate.
decision: Keep unresolved rather than classify from the school name.

issue: Partner material explicitly allows strand programmes alongside monolingual classrooms. The all-classroom statement names Twain and Irving, while Bonham distinguishes regular and DL pupils.
decision: Use named-campus scope; do not classify every SAISD academy as whole-school.

issue: Current all-student DL page differs from the provisional strand observation in the 2021-22 user inventory.
decision: Resolve current selection only; preserve history and leave transition date unestablished.
